plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of lights filmed in November 2024 right near the Brunswick nuclear power plant, run by the power company Duke Energy, in Southport, North Carolina. In a later episode with Mick West, a well-known UFO skeptic, he calls it unexplained aerial activity near a Duke Energy nuclear site, with the facility named only as Duke Energy. The story matters because it would add to claims that unknown objects take an interest in nuclear sites.
